title: Hebrews 11:4 — Abel commended as righteous, he still speaks
summary: Hebrews 11:4 (second part) with its Greek reference: by faith he [Abel] was commended as righteous when God approved his gifts, and by faith he still speaks even though he is dead. The pronouns 'he' and 'his' and the name Abel are in blue.

text.text: 4 …By faith he [Abel] was commended as righteous when God gave approval to his gifts. And by faith he still speaks, even though he is dead.

keywords: obtained witness that he was righteous
God gave approval to his gifts
